high_level_description: A vertical mixed-media editorial flow diagram mapping the Nexus V1 journey from a human need through typed artefacts, compiled execution, publication, public explanation, and feedback, using a clear serpentine route, retro magazine cutouts, dimensional headings, and restrained French labels.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Solid cobalt-blue poster field with coral-red corner brackets, mustard-yellow edge markers, and generous empty margins around the centered composition, preserving a clean vertical reading direction from top to bottom.

elements.desc: Large pale-cream vertical map sheet with an irregular torn perimeter, thin black inner border, seven empty diagram stations arranged in an alternating two-column sequence, and small cobalt registration marks that establish a precise editorial information surface.

Continuous coral-red serpentine route connecting seven stations in strict sequence from upper left to lower center, using thick black-edged arrows between every station and a final cobalt return curve rising along the right margin toward the first station.

Small uppercase bold upright sans-serif collection label centered at the top of the cream map sheet, colored cobalt blue with wide letter spacing and ample surrounding space above the main explanatory headline.

Large uppercase bold upright display headline centered across two lines, built from cream dimensional letters with coral-red side faces, thin black outlines, compact leading, and strong visual priority over every diagram label.

First diagram station shaped as a mustard-yellow speech-card containing a simple black human profile and one coral question mark, representing an expressed need before technical objects and automated processes exist.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label inside the first station, printed in black at large readable size with no subtitle, establishing the human starting point of the complete artefact chain.

Second diagram station formed by two overlapping cream research folders joined by a small coral decision seal, with source cards entering the first folder and one checked decision card leaving the second.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label stacked across two lines inside the second station, colored cobalt blue with a coral arrow, presenting research maturation and human arbitration as two distinct typed artefacts.

Third diagram station shaped as a cobalt architectural dossier holding three mustard analysis sheets, a coral risk triangle, and one selected plan card, representing product and technical conception without showing code fabrication.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label inside the third station, printed in pale cream at a single readable size and positioned beneath the dossier symbol without added explanation and decoration.

Fourth diagram station combining an editable coral node graph on the left with a black Rust compiler gear and a sealed cobalt plan tablet on the right, showing transformation from authored workflow into an immutable execution plan.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label stacked across two lines inside the fourth station, using cream lettering and one mustard arrow to emphasize that compilation transforms rather than merely copies the workflow.

Fifth diagram station formed by a compact runtime machine feeding an append-only paper journal, three artifact cards, and one signed receipt ticket, with every output visibly attached to the same run identifier ribbon.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label arranged across two lines inside the fifth station, colored cobalt blue with coral arrows, keeping execution, produced artifacts, and receipts visibly distinct but sequential.

Sixth diagram station showing a sealed software archive bound to a source commit card and signed provenance certificate, then placed inside a content-addressed cobalt package ready for peer-to-peer distribution without changing authorship.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label stacked across two lines inside the sixth station, printed in cream with a mustard arrow and enough surrounding space to separate publication evidence from execution receipts.

Final wide diagram station combining a cobalt search lens, a cream Proof Card, three community use cards, and a coral feedback arrow returning toward the human-need station, representing discovery, interpretation, reuse, and renewed needs.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the final station, printed in black with coral arrows, giving public discovery, concrete use, and feedback equal status in the closing loop for immediate visual recognition.

Large uppercase bold upright sans-serif closing statement centered near the bottom of the cream sheet, colored pale cream inside a distressed coral-red strip with a black outline and no secondary text.

high_level_description: A vertical mixed-media editorial cutaway diagram explaining the Nexus local node trust boundary, with a sandboxed app requesting one typed operation through a narrow bridge while the trusted shell, secret vault, Rust daemon, and runtime retain control.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Solid cobalt-blue poster field with a coral-red exterior network band along the bottom and generous empty margins around the central cutaway, clearly separating the protected local area from the surrounding network.

elements.desc: Large pale-cream local-node enclosure with a thick black perimeter, a vertical coral security partition through its center, one narrow controlled opening in that partition, and a small mustard identity seal fixed near the upper-right corner.

Small uppercase bold upright sans-serif collection label centered near the top edge, printed in cream with wide spacing and positioned above the main title without touching the local-node enclosure for immediate visual recognition.

Oversized uppercase bold upright display headline centered across two lines, using cream dimensional letters with coral-red side faces and black outlines to frame the diagram as a question about authority boundaries.

Sandboxed SBFB web application enclosed inside a transparent black-edged frame, containing a small cobalt interface, three coral action cards, and an opaque-origin badge, with no direct cable reaching the filesystem, private keys, and exterior network.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label attached to the top of the sandbox frame, printed in cobalt blue on a cream tab and kept separate from all interface-like decorative marks inside the application.

Security prohibition cluster containing a private key, a filesystem folder, and a network globe, each covered by one coral-red barred circle, visually stating three unavailable direct powers without adding explanatory microtext.

Narrow typed bridge checkpoint embedded in the central security partition, formed by one mustard input socket, a black validation gate, a cobalt allowlist card, and a single coral output socket allowing only validated operations through.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label stacked inside the bridge checkpoint, printed in cream with compact leading and enough clear space to remain readable at small book reproduction size for immediate visual recognition.

Trusted shell control panel with a clear effect summary, destination card, data card, cost card, and one prominent human-confirmation control, presented as a privileged host interface rather than content drawn inside the sandboxed application.
Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label above the trusted control panel, printed in coral red on a cream header strip and visually anchored inside the trusted side of the local node.

Local secret vault represented as a sturdy cobalt safe with a mustard keyway, three sealed credential capsules, and a short protected cable leading only toward the runtime, never toward the sandboxed application nor the exterior network.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the vault door, printed in pale cream with wide tracking and no surrounding pseudo-labels, reinforcing that credential values remain controlled by the host.

Rust daemon and workflow runtime represented as one black mechanical engine with a cobalt shield, mustard policy dials, coral journal tape, and a signed receipt slot, receiving only the operation that survived the bridge and host decisions.
Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label above the engine, printed in cream on a cobalt panel with a thin black border and positioned away from the receipt slot and policy dials.

Single bounded outbound-effect capsule crossing from the local node into the exterior network band, carrying one destination pin, one digest seal, and one attached receipt stub while every other possible route remains visibly closed.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label inside the outbound capsule, printed in pale cream against coral red with generous tracking and no implication that authorization automatically guarantees successful completion for immediate visual recognition.

Large uppercase bold upright sans-serif closing statement centered inside a distressed cream strip at the bottom, colored black with a coral period and no extra captions and no invented explanatory lines.

high_level_description: A vertical mixed-media editorial process diagram showing an editable Nexus workflow becoming a signed portable pack, passing through the authoritative Rust compiler, freezing into an immutable CompiledPlan, and driving a durable run journal that models cannot rewrite.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Solid cobalt-blue poster field with three pale-cream process zones arranged vertically, coral-red divider bars between them, and a narrow mustard-yellow execution rail descending through the center from authoring to durable evidence.

elements.desc: Small uppercase bold upright sans-serif collection label centered at the top, printed in cream with wide tracking and positioned above the main title as the authoring context for the entire process.

elements.text:
LE PLAN EST FIGÉ
AVANT L’ACTION
elements.desc: Oversized uppercase bold upright display headline centered across two lines, built from cream dimensional letters with coral-red side faces and black outlines, giving the immutability rule the strongest hierarchy for immediate visual recognition.

Editable workflow canvas shown as a cream drafting board with six colored nodes, typed ports, two branching arrows, one human-review diamond, and visible pencil handles, emphasizing that the graph remains modifiable before compilation.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label attached to the workflow drafting board, printed in cobalt blue on a mustard tab and kept separate from node identifiers and interface-like decorative marks.

Signed portable pack represented as a closed coral dossier containing pinned workflow, agent, prompt, schema, evaluation, and provenance cards, all linked to one black digest lock and one mustard signature seal.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label on the closed dossier, printed in pale cream with wide tracking and no additional version number, signature string, hash characters, and no pseudo-document text for immediate visual recognition.

Authoritative Rust compiler machine formed by a black gear, cobalt verification shield, four input inspection slots, and one narrow output press, rejecting a broken reference card while accepting only a fully bound deterministic plan.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the compiler machine, printed in cream on a coral-red nameplate with a thin black outline and no competing small labels for immediate visual recognition.

Medium uppercase bold upright sans-serif inspection summary centered beneath the compiler nameplate, colored black on pale cream with coral bullet marks separating the four static checks before a plan exists.

Immutable CompiledPlan tablet enclosed inside a clear black-edged case, containing a fixed node topology, capability closure, budget rulers, human-gate markers, artifact digests, and one plan seal, with no editing handles and no open ports.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the sealed plan case, printed in cobalt blue on a cream strip with enough spacing to remain readable without resembling editable interface content.

Blocked model-generated branch represented by a coral node fragment approaching the sealed plan case and stopping against a black barrier, with a return arrow directing the proposed change back toward a new workflow version.

elements.text: PAS DE BRANCHE AJOUTÉE EN COURS DE RUN
elements.desc: Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif warning beside the blocked branch, printed in black over mustard yellow and split across a compact readable block without any subordinate explanation for immediate visual recognition.

Durable execution section combining a cobalt runtime engine, an append-only cream journal ribbon, ordered RunEvent stamps, artifact cards, and signed receipt tickets, all permanently linked to the exact sealed plan digest above.

Large uppercase bold upright sans-serif label inside the runtime engine, printed in pale cream and isolated from the event ribbon so the execution instance remains visually distinct from its recorded evidence.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label following the durable journal ribbon, printed in cobalt blue with coral arrows and ample spacing between the three output categories for immediate visual recognition.

Large uppercase bold upright sans-serif closing statement centered inside a distressed coral-red strip, printed in pale cream with a black offset edge and no extra caption and no version identifier for immediate visual recognition.

high_level_description: A vertical mixed-media editorial funnel diagram explaining the seven authority layers that monotonically reduce requested Nexus powers into one effective capability, using seven visibly narrowing gates, exact French labels, strong arrows, and no decorative narrative scene.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Solid cobalt-blue poster field with coral-red side brackets, mustard-yellow measurement ticks, and wide alternating label areas on both sides of the centered authority path, preserving a strict vertical reading order.

elements.desc: Small uppercase bold upright sans-serif collection label centered near the top edge, printed in cream with wide tracking and positioned above the main headline without entering the funnel corridor for immediate visual recognition.

Oversized uppercase bold upright display headline centered across two lines, using cream dimensional letters with coral-red side faces and black outlines to establish an explicitly explanatory technical poster for immediate visual recognition.

Single vertical authority funnel with seven stacked black-edged gates, each opening narrower than the previous one, a wide coral input tray at the top, and one small mustard capability token emerging from the bottom.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif input label inside the wide coral tray above the first gate, printed in pale cream with generous spacing and no additional request examples for immediate visual recognition.

First rectangular filter gate in the funnel, colored cobalt blue with a mustard operating-system toggle symbol and a centered narrow passage that removes classes disabled by the host environment for immediate visual recognition.
Right-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the first gate, printed in pale cream on a short coral tab and positioned level with the gate opening for immediate visual recognition.

Second rectangular filter gate, colored coral red with a cobalt policy shield and a slightly narrower central passage that applies the initiating node's explicit local allow-map and stricter field bounds.

Left-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the second gate, printed in cream on a cobalt tab and positioned level with the gate opening without overlapping the funnel for immediate visual recognition.

Third rectangular filter gate, colored mustard yellow with a black release-card seal and a narrower passage representing live, unexpired, non-revoked authority granted specifically to the installed application release for immediate visual recognition.

Right-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the third gate, printed in black on a cream tab and kept on one compact line to preserve exact grant audience wording for immediate visual recognition.

Fourth rectangular filter gate, colored cobalt blue with a coral pack-version seal and a narrower passage representing the separate live grant required for the exact workflow pack version for immediate visual recognition.
Left-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the fourth gate, printed in pale cream on a coral tab and visually separated from the release grant above for immediate visual recognition.

Fifth rectangular filter gate, colored coral red with a black sealed-plan tablet and a narrower passage allowing only capability references already present inside the immutable CompiledPlan closure for immediate visual recognition.

Right-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the fifth gate, printed in black on a cream tab and sized to remain readable while preserving the complete technical meaning for immediate visual recognition.

Sixth rectangular filter gate, colored mustard yellow with a cobalt single-effect target symbol and a narrower passage reducing the surviving authority to the one capability declared as necessary by the current effect.
Left-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the sixth gate, printed in black on a cream tab with compact spacing and no examples of effect types for immediate visual recognition.

Seventh and narrowest rectangular filter gate, colored cobalt blue with a coral human-decision seal and a tiny central passage that remains closed for human-level effects unless a still-valid host decision exists.
Right-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif label beside the seventh gate, printed in pale cream on a coral tab and positioned level with the final gate opening for immediate visual recognition.

Small mustard capability token emerging beneath the seventh gate, shaped as a bounded key with a destination pin, quota notch, timeout dial, data-policy stripes, and approval seal integrated into one coherent symbol.

Left-aligned uppercase bold upright sans-serif output label beside the capability token, printed in cream inside a coral-red capsule with a black outline and no subordinate details for immediate visual recognition.

elements.text:
CHAQUE COUCHE PEUT RÉDUIRE.
AUCUNE NE PEUT ÉLARGIR.
elements.desc: Large uppercase bold upright sans-serif closing rule centered across two lines inside a distressed cream strip, printed in black with coral punctuation and given strong separation from the funnel output.

high_level_description: A vertical mixed-media editorial provenance diagram tracing a Nexus release from a pinned source commit through archive construction, signed provenance, content addressing, gossip discovery, local verification, and a readable Proof Card, while clearly separating evidence from truth.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Solid cobalt-blue poster field with coral-red outer border fragments, mustard-yellow stage markers, generous empty margins, and a distinct lower public-discovery zone separated from the upper publication zone by one black horizontal rule.

elements.desc: Continuous black-edged mustard verification arrow following the zigzag sequence from source commit to archive, provenance, content-addressed blob, gossip announcement, receiving node, and Proof Card, with no shortcut between nonadjacent stages.

Small uppercase bold upright sans-serif collection label centered near the top edge, printed in cream with wide tracking and positioned above the provenance headline without touching the verification path for immediate visual recognition.

elements.text:
DE LA SOURCE
À LA PREUVE LISIBLE
elements.desc: Oversized uppercase bold upright display headline centered across two lines, built from cream dimensional letters with coral-red side faces and black outlines, prioritizing the transformation from technical evidence into public explanation.

Public source repository represented as a cobalt code folder containing one cream commit card, a black branch line, and a mustard pin fixing an exact revision, with no mutable working-tree files outside the selected commit.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label on the repository folder, printed in pale cream with generous tracking and no fabricated repository name, forge logo, branch name, and no commit hash for immediate visual recognition.

Immutable application archive represented as a sealed coral package containing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and asset cards, with one black content digest band wrapping the complete package and no open editing flap.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the sealed package, printed in pale cream at a large readable size with no filename, extension, checksum characters, and no secondary caption for immediate visual recognition.

Signed provenance certificate linking the pinned source commit to the sealed archive, using two matching digest seals, one cobalt builder identity stamp, a black connecting line, and a mustard signature ribbon.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the certificate, printed in cobalt blue on a cream header strip and isolated from all decorative digest marks to prevent accidental pseudo-text for immediate visual recognition.

Content-addressed Iroh blob represented as a cobalt hexagonal container enclosing the archive, with a black fingerprint border and three identical mustard address tokens showing that peers request the content by its derived address.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label stacked across two lines inside the blob container, printed in pale cream with compact leading and no sample hash and no network address for immediate visual recognition.

Gossip discovery announcement represented as a coral broadcast card leaving the publishing node through three black radio arcs, carrying only a content pointer, publisher identity seal, version marker, and provenance reference rather than archive bytes.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label on the broadcast card, printed in pale cream with wide tracking and excluding voting, consensus, ranking, and centralized catalogue authority for immediate visual recognition.

Receiving local node represented as a cream verification desk with a cobalt signature shield, black hash comparison scale, coral source-link card, and mustard freshness clock, assembling facts locally after fetching the referenced content.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label above the verification desk, printed in cobalt blue on a cream strip and separated from the factual evidence symbols beneath it for immediate visual recognition.

Readable Proof Card beside an RRV search lens, displaying distinct visual rows for hash, source, signature, license, freshness, risk, and curation, with a large evidence meter that never transforms into a truth badge.

Centered uppercase bold upright sans-serif label across the public explanation panel, printed in cream on cobalt blue with a coral separator and no claim of certification, correctness, and no universal ranking.

elements.text:
LA PREUVE DIT CE QU’ELLE GARANTIT.
ELLE NE DÉCRÈTE PAS LA VÉRITÉ.
elements.desc: Large uppercase bold upright sans-serif closing statement centered across two lines inside a distressed coral-red strip, printed in pale cream with black outlines and given the strongest hierarchy after the headline.
